sentence: The limits of my language mean the limits of my world.

source.author: Ludwig Wittgenstein
source.detail: 命题 5.6；德文首版 1921，英译本 1922；原德文：Die Grenzen meiner Sprache bedeuten die Grenzen meiner Welt

translation: 我的语言的界限，意味着我的世界的界限。
grammar: 主干很清楚：The limits（主语）+ mean（谓语）+ the limits（宾语）。两头都是 the limits，中间用 mean 连接，形成对称。
of my language / of my world 是介词短语作后置定语，分别修饰前后两个 limits，说明「哪方面的界限」。整句结构是 The limits of A mean the limits of B。
这里的 mean 不是「打算」，而是「意味着、等于」。哲学里常把语言和世界绑在一起：你能说清的，才是你能把握的。学英语，也是在拓宽自己的世界。

vocab.meaning: 界限；限度；极限（句中常用复数 limits）
vocab.collocation: the limits of; push the limits; within limits
vocab.example: Debugging without a scope can push the limits of what you can see on a bare-metal board.

vocab.meaning: 语言；也引申为表达方式、术语体系
vocab.collocation: spoken / written language; a programming language; in plain language
vocab.example: In datasheets, the same idea is often said in denser language than in app notes.

vocab.meaning: 意味着；表示（不是「刻薄」那个形容词）
vocab.collocation: mean that; what does it mean; mean the world to someone
vocab.example: A rising IRQ line can mean the peripheral has finished a transfer.

vocab.meaning: 世界；也可指某人的生活范围、领域
vocab.collocation: the world of; in one's own world; a whole new world
vocab.example: Learning English opens a whole new world of docs, talks, and open-source threads.

note: 学英语不只是背单词，也是在把「说不清」变成「说得清」。今天试着把这句改写成你的版本，比如：The limits of my vocabulary mean the limits of my clarity.
